content_record.title: Universal transcriptomic hallmarks of mammalian ageing and mortality
content_record.editorial_body: A multi-species transcriptomic analysis reveals conserved ageing signatures and modular clocks, linking inflammation, mitochondrial function, and chromatin dynamics to mortality. Three things to remember - 11,000+ transcriptomes across 4 mammals identify conserved ageing genes. - CDKN1A and LGALS3 protein levels correlate with human mortality. - Caloric restriction and Klotho target mitochondrial and metabolic modules. Source This signal is based on Universal transcriptomic hallmarks of mammalian ageing and mortality. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Observational transcriptomic study; causality not established.
